segments.text: Introducing new M R S!

segments.caption: a fork of niri, inspired by newm and by KDE
segments.text: A fork of niri, inspired by new-M, and by amazing desktop environments like KDE.

segments.caption: built on principles
segments.text: Built on principles.

segments.caption: Tiled windows never overlap other tiled windows
segments.text: One. Tiled windows never overlap other tiled windows.

segments.caption: A window is never bigger than its display
segments.text: Two. A window is never bigger than its display.

segments.caption: Zoom is a camera
segments.text: Three. Zoom is a camera: no app is ever resized by a zoom.

segments.caption: Changing focus moves the camera as little as possible
segments.text: Four. Changing focus moves the camera as little as possible.

segments.caption: Moving the mouse without a click changes nothing
segments.text: Five. Moving the mouse without a click changes nothing.

segments.caption: Everything the mouse can do, the keyboard can do too
segments.text: Six. Everything the mouse can do, the keyboard can do too.

segments.caption: One hand is enough
segments.text: Seven. One hand is enough.

segments.caption: The left hand alone works too
segments.text: Eight. The left hand alone works too.

segments.caption: As fast and as stable as possible
segments.text: Nine. As fast and as stable as possible: forty-six microseconds per layout, and disk writes never block the screen.

segments.caption: As compatible with KDE as possible
segments.text: Ten. As compatible with KDE as possible.

segments.caption: Beautiful and joyful to use
segments.text: Eleven. Beautiful, and joyful to use.

segments.caption: It respects your muscle memory
segments.text: Twelve. It respects your muscle memory.

segments.caption: a 2D grid of fixed tiles, apps drawn 1:1
segments.text: A grid of fixed tiles, every app drawn at its own size.

segments.caption: new windows open at the nearest free spot
segments.text: New windows open at the nearest free spot.

segments.caption: drag a window: the others step aside, live
segments.text: Drag a window, and the others step aside, live.

segments.caption: resize: a box shows where it lands
segments.text: Resize, and a box shows where it lands.

segments.caption: undo and redo every rearrangement
segments.text: Undo and redo everything.

segments.caption: zoom about the middle, back to 1:1
segments.text: Zoom about the middle, and one key brings you back to one to one.

segments.caption: the overview shows every window, the rest dimmed
segments.text: The overview shows every window, with the rest dimmed.

segments.caption: live thumbnails; the window lands centred
segments.text: Alt Tab shows live thumbnails, and centres the window.

segments.caption: log back in: every window returns to its tiles
segments.text: Log out and back in: every window returns to its tiles.

segments.caption: terminals reattach, browsers reopen their tabs
segments.text: Terminals reattach their sessions, and browsers reopen their tabs.

segments.caption: the lock screen stays locked
segments.text: The lock screen stays locked, even if the locker crashes.

segments.caption: every toolkit, crisp at fractional scale 1.25
segments.text: GTK, Qt and KDE, Firefox, Chromium and other browsers, Electron and X11 apps: all crisp at fractional scale.

segments.caption: KDE shortcuts, KRunner, KDE Connect, portals
segments.text: KDE shortcuts, KRunner, KDE Connect and the portals all work.

segments.caption: every build runs real apps in a VM suite
segments.text: Every build runs real apps in a VM suite.
